response.overview: Eundal, a middle school girl, struggles with a deep-seated complex caused by flakes falling from  her scalp.  Fixated on the color white, she customizes even her school uniform, drawing attention from  those around her.  During a class discussion on “normality and abnormality,” Eundal voices her own beliefs. In that  moment, the flakes from her hair drift through the classroom, landing on the shoulder of Jihoon,  the boy she secretly admires. She hurriedly tries to remove them.  Soon, she discovers that Jihoon carries a similar insecurity. Through this realization, Eundal confronts the fragile and constructed nature of what society defines as “normal.”
response.title: Dead skin
